title: "Tidy Challenge"
output: html_document
date: "2026-10-15"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
```

### Step 1
```{r}
who1 <- who %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = new_sp_m014:newrel_f65, names_to = "key", values_to = "cases", values_drop_na = TRUE)
who1
```

### Step 2
```{r}
who2 <- who1 %>% 
  mutate(key = stringr::str_replace(key, "newrel", "new_rel"))
who2
```

### Step 3
```{r}
##Separate the values of key
who3 <- who2 %>% 
  separate(key, into = c("new", "type", "sexage"), sep = "_")
who3

##Separate the gender/age 
who4 <- who3 %>% 
  separate(sexage, into = c("sex", "age"), sep = 1)
who4

##Separate low and hight age
who5 <- who4 %>% 
  mutate(age = stringr::str_replace(age, "014", "0014")) %>%
  mutate(age = stringr::str_replace(age, "65", "65100")) %>%
  separate(age, into = c("age_low", "age_high"), sep = 2)
```

### Step 4
```{r}
who5 %>% count(new)

# drop redundant columns
who6 <- who5 %>% 
  select(-new, -iso2, -iso3)
who6
```


### Step pipe
```{r}
who0 <- who %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = new_sp_m014:newrel_f65, names_to = "key", values_to = "cases", values_drop_na = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(key = stringr::str_replace(key, "newrel", "new_rel")) %>%
  separate(key, into = c("new", "type", "sexage"), sep = "_") %>%
  separate(sexage, into = c("sex", "age"), sep = 1) %>%
  mutate(age = stringr::str_replace(age, "014", "0014"), age = stringr::str_replace(age, "65", "65100")) %>%
  separate(age, into = c("age_low", "age_high"), sep = 2) %>%
  select(-new, -iso2, -iso3)
who0
```
